title.zh: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor
title.en: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor

current_state.zh: Anchorage Digital expanded its custody-and-listing arrangement with Bitso to support stablecoin flows across the US-Mexico remittance corridor, including multi-chain custody of MXNB and listings of Western Union and Tether dollar stablecoins.
current_state.en: Anchorage Digital expanded its custody-and-listing arrangement with Bitso to support stablecoin flows across the US-Mexico remittance corridor, including multi-chain custody of MXNB and listings of Western Union and Tether dollar stablecoins.

updates.title_zh: Anchorage 布局美墨稳定币走廊，力图成为托管支柱
updates.title_en: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor
updates.what_changed_zh:
Anchorage Digital 于周二宣布扩大与 Bitso 的托管与上币安排：Anchorage Digital Bank 现已在 Arbitrum、Base、Ethereum、Polygon、Avalanche 和 Arc 六条区块链上托管 Bitso 的墨西哥比索稳定币 MXNB。Bitso 则相应上线了 USDPT 与 USAT，这两款分别来自 Western Union 和 Tether 的美元稳定币由 Anchorage 发行并托管。双方未披露财务条款。

该安排让一家获得联邦牌照的加密银行同时覆盖这条每年转移数百亿美元汇款通道的两端，而其中约 15% 的资金已通过 Bitso 的基础设施流转。Anchorage 首席执行官 Nathan McCauley 称，这条走廊正是“稳定币不再只是论点、而是开始规模化转移真实资金”的地方。

Bitso 稳定币负责人 Ben Reid 表示，客户现在可以在完全链上的环境中使用完整的美元—比索通道，并由一家联邦牌照银行提供支撑。这条走廊的很大一部分资金目前仍通过代理行、电汇和现金取款网络流转。
updates.what_changed_en: Anchorage Digital expanded its custody-and-listing arrangement with Bitso to support stablecoin flows across the US-Mexico remittance corridor, including multi-chain custody of MXNB and listings of Western Union and Tether dollar stablecoins.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anchorage Digital expanded its custody-and-listing arrangement with Bitso to support stablecoin flows across the US-Mexico remittance corridor, including multi-chain custody of MXNB and listings of Western Union and Tether dollar stablecoins.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anchorage Digital expanded its custody-and-listing arrangement with Bitso to support stablecoin flows across the US-Mexico remittance corridor, including multi-chain custody of MXNB and listings of Western Union and Tether dollar stablecoins.
updates.background_zh: MXNB 是由 Bitso 子公司 Juno 发行的墨西哥比索锚定稳定币，以比索储备 1:1 支撑，并已在 Arbitrum 等网络上推广。Western Union 一直在筹备 USDPT，用于绕开 SWIFT 的国际交易。此次交易正值稳定币基础设施在拉美扩张之际，包括 Circle 在哥伦比亚的 USDC 结算试点，以及其为稳定币支付打造的 Arc 一层区块链。
updates.background_en: MXNB is a Mexican peso-pegged stablecoin issued by Bitso subsidiary Juno, backed 1:1 by peso reserves, and has been pushed across networks including Arbitrum. Western Union has been preparing USDPT for international transactions that bypass SWIFT. The deal comes as stablecoin infrastructure expands across Latin America, including Circle's USDC settlement pilot in Colombia and its Arc layer-1 blockchain built for stablecoin payments.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该交易将一部分跨境汇款结算引向受监管、由银行托管的稳定币通道，为走廊两端的机构发行方提供比索与美元代币的托管场所。其影响集中在六条受支持链上 MXNB、USDPT 和 USAT 的流动性，而非整体市场，因此近期的传导渠道是区域性支付流量与托管份额，而非全系统流动性。
updates.market_impact_en: The deal shifts a slice of cross-border remittance settlement toward regulated, bank-custodied stablecoin rails, giving institutional issuers on both sides of the corridor a custody venue for peso- and dollar-denominated tokens. Exposure concentrates in MXNB, USDPT and USAT liquidity across the six supported chains rather than in the broader market, so the near-term transmission channel is regional payment flow and custody share rather than system-wide liquidity.
